description: Resolve a security identifier (ticker, ISIN, CUSIP, SEDOL or FIGI) or an instrument name to canonical FIGI records via OpenFIGI, Bloomberg's open symbology, with provenance and a signed receipt. Returns matched, instruments and provenance. Useful whenever a claim, order or document names a security: it shows exactly which instrument is meant, disambiguating tickers that collide across exchanges, and the receipt proves the mapping. An explicit identifier resolves more reliably than a plain name; id_type is auto-detected from the value's shape when omitted. Limits: conservative by design, it resolves explicit identifiers and returns matched=false rather than guessing on an ambiguous plain name. It covers securities in OpenFIGI's symbology only and does not price instruments, return fundamentals or resolve crypto tokens. Paid per call (x402).

id_type.description: Optional identifier type; auto-detected from the value's shape (e.g. 12-char alphanumeric -> ISIN).

query.description: Ticker, ISIN, CUSIP, SEDOL, FIGI, or instrument name.
